## Checklist

- [ ] Every number links to a measurement (yours or published)
- [ ] Adapted commands are marked *untested, from &lt;source&gt;*, or include raw output showing they ran
- [ ] New container images have a `linux/arm64` variant
- [ ] No large verbatim copies of third-party docs (summary + link; commands are fine)
- [ ] For benchmark rows: `metric` (`decode` / `output_run` / `total_in_out`) and `scope` (`per_request` / `aggregate`) are set, and `reliability` follows [benchmarks/README.md](../benchmarks/README.md)
- [ ] Commands copied from a new third-party source are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
